format: html

library(tidyverse)
#| message: false
execute:
  echo: false

```{r}
#| cache: true
billboard <- readr::read_csv("data/billboard.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
print(billboard)
```

```{r}
billboard |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = wk1)) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(binwidth = 10, boundary = 0.5) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Week 1 ranking",
    y = "Number of songs",
    subtitle = paste("Values plotted:", sum(!is.na(billboard$wk1)))
  )
```
